input.command: D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXX) && git diff --cached > "$D/staged.patch" && git show HEAD:formatting.py > "$D/base-formatting.py" && git show HEAD:tests/test_report.py > "$D/base-test_report.py" && git ls-tree HEAD formatting.py tests/test_report.py config.py && echo "$D" && wc -l "$D"/*
input.description: Write staged diff and base blobs to temp evidence dir
